'''2014 Match Play Championship Day 1 Matt Paragano LS The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matt Paragano]] at [[2014 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

* '''Starting Card:''' [[The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone]]
* '''Username:''' SugarStyle
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
